name: AutoNav
description: Automates nav mesh generation for Source Engine games during compile-time. Does not support Left 4 Dead 1/2; see readme for CS:GO usage.

inputs.description: The compiled map. Gates scheduling (nav generation must run after the BSP is compiled and copied into the game's maps folder); the tool reads it via the live game, not off the command line.

outputs.description: The generated .nav navigation mesh, written into the game's maps folder next to the .bsp.

arguments.name: Map
arguments.description: The name of the map to build, without extension.

arguments.name: Game Directory
arguments.description: The mod folder to be loaded.

arguments.name: Console mode
arguments.description: How console commands reach the game. "exec" relaunches it with -hijack +exec and is the default; "rcon" talks over the network and needs a listen server; "auto" picks by what the game supports. Stated rather than detected, so a run behaves the same every time.
arguments.warning: CS:GO cannot be hijacked - use rcon or auto alongside --steam and --appid.

arguments.name: Steam Executable
arguments.description: Specify the steam.exe for a Steam-based game launch.
arguments.warning: Required alongside Steam AppId for CS:GO. See readme for CS:GO usage.

arguments.name: Steam AppId
arguments.description: For use with --steam; specifies the Steam AppId for game launches.
